overview: Extract ReminderEditorViewModel from ReminderEditorView (424 lines). View manages form state (ReminderDraft), save pipeline, subtask CRUD, notification scheduling, and dirty tracking. VM takes all business logic.
goals: Create @Observable ReminderEditorViewModel owning draft state, save/validate, dirty tracking, subtask CRUD, notification scheduling
Reduce ReminderEditorView from ~424 lines to ~200 lines
Full save/discard flow becomes testable without sheet presentation
nonGoals: No changes to ReminderDraft or ReminderDraftMapper interfaces
No form layout or animation changes
successMetrics: ReminderEditorViewModel.swift created with init, save(), handleClose(), and subtask methods
Creating and editing tasks works identically
rules: View passes @Query results (lists, tags) to VM on init and update
VM uses existing ReminderDraftMapper.apply() for save pipeline
View retains @FocusState, expandedPicker, pressedRow UI state
